The challenge against PVB_37 (commitment 2) came back invalid, and I lost a $50 bond, even though its declared 2629.4 kW is about 8% above the 2435 kW nameplate. I did not challenge PVB_17 or PVB_32, which are below nameplate. I also did not challenge PVB_50, whose 6837.4 kW exceeds its 6837 kW nameplate by only 0.4 kW, which looks like rounding rather than a false claim. The server's verdict suggests its tolerance is looser than my reading of the rule, so I should flag this before challenging again.
